title: A股港股早报：激光雷达与锂电映射升温，油价利率压估值 + 美股盘前：就业意外转负推低利率，软件强反馈接力AI权重
summary: 7月非农意外减少2.3万人，10年期美债回落、期指走高；TEAM、NET、FROG、TWLO、AKAM等软件财报强反馈接力AI权重，TTD、SEZL、DDOG仍提示高预期惩罚，今晚可验证盘后大型科技财报样本不足。

entries.label: 美股盘前
entries.title: 美股盘前：就业意外转负推低利率，软件强反馈接力AI权重
entries.title_en: US Premarket: Negative Payrolls Lower Yields, Software Strength Joins AI Megacaps
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
就业
美国7月非农意外减少2.3万人，利率压力先降温
就业数据从预期新增约8.5万至8.8万人转为减少2.3万人，失业率约4.1%；期指把它解读为增长放缓但利率下行的组合，10年期美债从约4.67%回落至4.60%-4.62%区域。
指数
美股期指跳升，Nasdaq 100 领涨风险资产
就业报告后，道指期货约涨0.3%，标普500期货约涨0.5%，Nasdaq 100期货约涨1.2%；开盘基调从非农前谨慎转向“利率回落 + 财报强者优先”。
能源
油价从周四急涨后回落，但霍尔木兹风险仍在
WTI约76.9美元，布伦特从高位回落约0.6%-0.7%；伊朗、阿曼及霍尔木兹相关谈判仍不稳定，能源通胀风险没有彻底解除。
避险
黄金继续受到降息预期和政策可信度交易支撑
金价盘前仍强，体现投资者一边买入利率回落交易，一边保留对通胀、财政和地缘风险的对冲。
软件
Atlassian (TEAM) 财报后大涨，成为软件反弹核心
TEAM盘前涨幅约28%-32%，业绩和前瞻指引均优于预期，价格反馈显示市场愿意重新奖励能证明AI没有侵蚀需求的软件公司。
软件
Cloudflare (NET)、JFrog (FROG)、Twilio (TWLO) 集体强涨
NET约涨16%，FROG约涨19%，TWLO约涨17%；这些公司共同修复前一日软件高预期惩罚带来的恐慌，但开盘后仍要看高开承接。
网络
Akamai (AKAM) 财报后约涨15%，网络基础设施线索扩散
AKAM二季度表现好于预期，和NET一起强化“AI网络、边缘计算、安全交付”方向，而不是泛化买入所有软件。
广告
The Trade Desk (TTD) 盘前重挫，广告科技仍有负反馈
TTD盘前跌幅约26%，属于“高预期 + 指引/增长担忧”被惩罚的样本，只能放在压力和风险观察，不能写成多头推荐。
金融科技
Sezzle (SEZL) 盘前大跌，投机成长股风险未解除
SEZL盘前跌幅约24%，说明就业弱化和利率下行并不会自动托住所有高估值、高波动标的。
财报日历
Take-Two (TTWO) 已盘前披露，不属于今晚盘后 beat 样本
TTWO财报显示EPS和净预订略高于预期，但全年预订展望未上调、盘前表现摇摆；Nasdaq、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger等日历未确认今晚盘后有值得分层的大型科技公司。

盘前结论

今天开盘前最重要的变化是就业数据已经落地：非农从市场预期的温和增加变成减少2.3万人，先把10年期美债从4.67%附近压回4.60%-4.62%区域。对股指而言，这短线缓和了估值压力，所以Nasdaq 100期指明显强于道指。

科技内部的主线也从昨天的“软件高预期惩罚”切换为“有指引、有承接的软件反弹”。TEAM、NET、FROG、TWLO、AKAM的盘前强涨说明资金愿意买回能证明需求韧性的公司；但TTD、SEZL、DDOG这类负反馈样本仍提醒，不能把利率下行简单等同于所有成长股普涨。

开盘后基准判断是偏强震荡：若10年期美债维持在4.62%下方，Nasdaq和软件ETF有望延续反弹；若投资者把负非农解读为盈利衰退信号，或强势软件高开低走，指数会从利率交易转回增长担忧。

重点个股推荐

Atlassian
TEAM
软件龙头强反馈

推荐理由：财报和前瞻指引推动盘前约28%-32%上涨，是今天软件板块最清晰的正反馈样本。

触发因素：若开盘后仍能守住盘前涨幅的大部分，并且相对IGV继续走强，可确认资金从“AI冲击软件”转向“强软件重估”。

风险点：涨幅已经很大，若高开后量能衰减或10年期美债反弹，容易出现获利回吐。

Cloudflare
NET
AI网络基础设施

推荐理由：收入、EPS和全年指引均好于预期，盘前约16%上涨，价格反馈强于大多数软件同业。

触发因素：若开盘后NET继续强于Nasdaq 100和AKAM，说明市场认可AI流量、网络安全和边缘交付的需求韧性。

风险点：估值敏感度仍高，若软件反弹只是一日空头回补，高位承接会快速变弱。

JFrog
FROG
开发者工具修复

推荐理由：财报后盘前约19%上涨，和TEAM、TWLO一起证明开发者和企业软件并未被AI叙事全面挤压。

触发因素：若开盘后FROG强于中小软件篮子，并且回撤不跌破盘前核心区间，可作为高弹性软件修复观察。

风险点：市值和流动性小于大型软件，若风险偏好从成长股撤出，波动会高于NET和MSFT。

Microsoft
MSFT
AI权重托底

推荐理由：就业数据压低利率后，大型AI权重和云现金流资产仍是指数稳定器，MSFT比高波动软件更适合承担核心配置角色。

触发因素：若10年期美债维持在4.62%下方，且Nasdaq 100强于标普500，MSFT有望继续吸收低利率交易资金。

风险点：若负非农被重新定价为增长衰退，权重股也会被动承压，不能只看利率单一变量。

板块轮动看板

强势观察企业软件、AI网络基础设施、开发者工具、云与AI权重；TEAM、NET、FROG、TWLO、AKAM提供盘前价格确认。
事件驱动TTWO已盘前披露，beat但全年预订展望未上调，适合观察游戏链情绪，不适合作为今晚盘后预测对象。
压力方向TTD、SEZL、DDOG等负反馈样本说明广告科技、投机金融科技和高预期软件仍需回避追多。
验证信号开盘后看10Y是否守在4.62%下方、IGV是否放量、TEAM/NET是否高开不回落、TTD/SEZL弱势是否扩散。

逻辑链

宏观触发

非农意外转负先压低长端利率，释放高久期科技估值压力。

财报筛选

资金只追逐能给出强业绩、强指引、强价格反馈的软件公司。

科技分层

TEAM、NET、FROG、TWLO、AKAM强于TTD、SEZL、DDOG，说明软件内部不是普涨。

开盘策略

优先跟踪强反馈延续和AI权重托底，负反馈标的只做风险观察。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司。已检查 Nasdaq earnings calendar、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger、InvestingCalendar 和 MarketChameleon：8月7日最明确的科技样本 Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) 已在盘前/早间披露，不能作为今晚盘后即将披露的 beat 概率样本。

高概率无可验证盘后科技公司样本，因此不列高概率公司。
中概率无可验证盘后科技公司样本；若临近收盘有新增确认，需要重新核对发布时间、一致预期、历史surprise和盘前价格。
已披露样本Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) 已盘前披露，EPS和净预订略高于预期但全年预订展望未上调，只能作为已披露事件观察。

风险雷达

负非农若从“利率利好”切换为“增长放缓”，股指会从上涨转为盈利下修交易。

TTD、SEZL盘前重挫若扩散到更多成长股，软件强反馈可能被视为局部而非板块反转。

TEAM、NET、FROG涨幅较大，开盘后若无法放量承接，短线追高风险高。

霍尔木兹和油价风险仍在，若原油重新上行，会削弱利率下行带来的估值修复。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP、Investor's Business Daily、Barron's、MarketWatch、Investopedia、Investing.com、MarketBeat、InvestingCalendar、MarketChameleon、Nasdaq earnings calendar；抓取时间：2026-08-07 21:02 CST。部分实时成交深度和浏览器交互不可用，已按规则使用公开新闻、财报日历和盘前报价报道降级继续。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Jobs
US July payrolls unexpectedly fell by 23,000, cooling rate pressure first
The jobs report flipped from consensus for roughly 85,000-88,000 additions to a 23,000 decline, with unemployment near 4.1%; futures treated it as slower growth but lower rates, pulling the 10-year yield down from about 4.67% to the 4.60%-4.62% area.
Index
US futures jumped, with Nasdaq 100 leading risk assets
After the jobs report, Dow futures were up about 0.3%, S&P 500 futures about 0.5%, and Nasdaq 100 futures about 1.2%; the setup shifted from pre-payroll caution to “lower yields plus earnings winners first.”
Energy
Oil eased after Thursday's sharp rally, but Hormuz risk remains
WTI traded near $76.9 and Brent pulled back about 0.6%-0.7%; Iran, Oman, and Hormuz-related negotiations remain unstable, so energy inflation risk has not disappeared.
Haven
Gold stayed supported by easing expectations and policy-credibility hedges
Gold remained firm before the open, showing investors are buying the lower-rate trade while still hedging inflation, fiscal, and geopolitical risks.
Software
Atlassian (TEAM) surged after earnings, becoming the core software rebound
TEAM rose roughly 28%-32% premarket after results and forward guidance beat expectations, showing investors will reward software companies that prove AI is not eroding demand.
Software
Cloudflare (NET), JFrog (FROG), and Twilio (TWLO) rallied together
NET gained about 16%, FROG about 19%, and TWLO about 17%; together they repaired some fear from the prior day's software high-expectation penalty, but the open still needs follow-through.
Network
Akamai (AKAM) rose about 15% after earnings, extending network-infrastructure clues
AKAM's second quarter came in better than expected, and together with NET it strengthens the AI networking, edge-compute, and secure-delivery theme rather than a blanket software trade.
Ad Tech
The Trade Desk (TTD) plunged premarket, keeping ad-tech negative feedback alive
TTD fell about 26% premarket, a high-expectation plus growth/guidance-concern example; it belongs in pressure and risk observation, not a long recommendation.
Fintech
Sezzle (SEZL) dropped sharply premarket, showing speculative-growth risk remains
SEZL fell about 24% premarket, showing weaker employment and lower rates do not automatically support every high-valuation, high-volatility stock.
Calendar
Take-Two (TTWO) has already reported before the open, so it is not tonight's after-close beat sample
TTWO reported EPS and net bookings slightly above expectations, but did not raise full-year bookings guidance and traded unevenly premarket; Nasdaq, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, and related calendars did not confirm a large technology company worth after-close layering tonight.

Premarket View

The biggest pre-open change is that payrolls are already out: the market expected a modest gain, but the economy lost 23,000 jobs, pulling the 10-year Treasury yield back from around 4.67% to the 4.60%-4.62% area. For equities, that first reduces valuation pressure, so Nasdaq 100 futures are clearly stronger than Dow futures.

Technology's main line also shifted from yesterday's “software high-expectation penalty” to “software rebound with guidance and price confirmation.” TEAM, NET, FROG, TWLO, and AKAM show investors are willing to buy companies that prove demand resilience; TTD, SEZL, and DDOG still warn that lower rates do not mean all growth stocks rally together.

The base case for the open is a firmer range. If the 10-year yield holds below 4.62%, Nasdaq and software ETFs can extend the rebound. If investors reprice negative payrolls as an earnings-slowdown signal, or if strong software names fade after the open, the tape can shift from a rate trade back to growth concern.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.

Key Stock Picks

Atlassian
TEAM
Software leader feedback

Reason: earnings and forward guidance drove a roughly 28%-32% premarket rally, making it today's clearest positive software feedback sample.

Trigger: if it keeps most of the premarket gain after the open and continues outperforming IGV, investors are accepting a shift from “AI hurts software” to “strong software re-rating.”

Risk: the move is already large; if volume fades after a gap-up or the 10-year yield rebounds, profit-taking risk is high.

Cloudflare
NET
AI network infrastructure

Reason: revenue, EPS, and full-year guidance all beat expectations, and the stock rose about 16% premarket, a stronger price response than most software peers.

Trigger: if NET stays stronger than Nasdaq 100 and AKAM after the open, the market is accepting demand resilience in AI traffic, security, and edge delivery.

Risk: valuation sensitivity remains high; if the software rally is only one-day short covering, high-level demand can weaken quickly.

JFrog
FROG
Developer-tool repair

Reason: the stock rose about 19% premarket after earnings, and together with TEAM and TWLO it shows developer and enterprise software are not being fully crowded out by AI narratives.

Trigger: if FROG outperforms the mid-cap software basket after the open and does not break its core premarket range, it can serve as a high-beta software repair watch.

Risk: its market cap and liquidity are below large software peers; if risk appetite leaves growth stocks, volatility should exceed NET and MSFT.

Microsoft
MSFT
AI megacap support

Reason: after jobs data lowered rates, large AI weights and cloud cash-flow assets remain the index stabilizers, and MSFT is better suited for core exposure than high-volatility software.

Trigger: if the 10-year yield holds below 4.62% and Nasdaq 100 stays ahead of the S&P 500, MSFT should keep absorbing lower-rate trade flows.

Risk: if negative payrolls are repriced as recessionary growth risk, megacaps will also face passive selling pressure.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength WatchEnterprise software, AI network infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, and AI megacaps; TEAM, NET, FROG, TWLO, and AKAM provide premarket price confirmation.
Event DrivenTTWO has already reported before the open; the beat but unchanged full-year bookings outlook makes it a gaming-chain watch, not tonight's after-close prediction object.
Pressure AreasTTD, SEZL, and DDOG show that ad tech, speculative fintech, and high-expectation software still require chase-buying discipline.
Validation SignalsWatch whether the 10-year stays below 4.62%, IGV trades with volume, TEAM/NET hold gap-ups, and TTD/SEZL weakness spreads.

Logic Chain

Macro Trigger

Payrolls unexpectedly turned negative, first pulling long yields lower and releasing long-duration tech valuation pressure.

Earnings Filter

Investors are chasing only software companies with strong results, guidance, and price feedback.

Tech Layering

TEAM, NET, FROG, TWLO, and AKAM are stronger than TTD, SEZL, and DDOG, so software is not a blanket rally.

Open Strategy

Track strong-feedback continuation and AI megacap support first; keep negative-feedback names in risk observation.

After-Close Earnings Beat Probability

Verifiable after-close technology earnings companies are insufficient / no large technology company is verified. Checked Nasdaq earnings calendar, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, InvestingCalendar, and MarketChameleon: the clearest August 7 technology sample, Take-Two Interactive (TTWO), has already reported before the open / early morning and cannot be used as tonight's after-close beat-probability sample.

High ProbabilityNo verifiable after-close technology company sample, so no high-probability company is listed.
Medium ProbabilityNo verifiable after-close technology company sample; if a late confirmed company appears, release timing, consensus, historical surprise, and premarket price must be rechecked.
Reported SampleTake-Two Interactive (TTWO) has already reported before the open, with EPS and net bookings slightly above expectations but no raised full-year bookings outlook, so it is only a reported-event watch.

Risk Radar

If negative payrolls shift from “rate relief” to “growth slowdown,” indexes can move from rallying to earnings-cut trading.

If TTD and SEZL premarket plunges spread to more growth stocks, software strength may be treated as local rather than a sector reversal.

TEAM, NET, and FROG have already moved sharply; without open-session volume support, chase risk is high.

Hormuz and oil risks remain; if crude resumes rising, it will weaken the valuation repair from lower yields.

Sources and Timestamp

entries.summary: 隔夜美股指数小跌但结构分化，Futunn Sparks 显示激光雷达、锂矿、太空和外卖领涨；A/H 早盘重点看舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链的价格确认，油价与长债上行仍压制估值。
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
霍尔木兹不确定性继续推升油价，A/H 能源安全与航运链获得事件溢价
隔夜美股下跌的核心约束来自油价和美债收益率同步上行；中东/伊朗相关谈判与通航安排仍未形成稳定预期，A股油气、油服、航运和通胀受益链可能获得防御资金，但高油价会压制航空、化工中下游和高估值成长。
宏观
美国非农公布前长债收益率上行，港股成长股估值弹性受限
公开行情显示8月6日道指跌0.85%、标普500跌0.18%、纳指跌0.06%，10年期美债收益率升至约4.67%区域；若今晚非农偏强，港股互联网和A股高估值科技的反弹空间会先受利率约束。
科技
Futunn Sparks 隔夜最强链条是激光雷达、锂矿、太空与外卖
Sparks 正收益前五为激光雷达概念 +4.92%（AEVA +28.81%）、锂矿概念股 +3.99%（ALB +5.54%）、枪械制造 +3.72%（CDRE +12.86%）、太空概念 +3.44%（BKSY +10.37%）、外卖概念 +3.17%（UBER +3.36%）。A/H 映射重点看智能驾驶传感器、锂资源、低空经济/卫星互联网和美团。
软件
美股软件出现高预期惩罚，A/H 软件与云服务需要先看止跌
HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin、Figma、Duolingo 等软件股因业绩/指引和 AI 定价担忧遭遇抛售，显示市场不再简单奖励收入 beat；港股金蝶、明源云及 A股信创/软件服务更适合等成交企稳。
半导体
存储与半导体分化，AI PC 和光通信仍有结构性映射
Sandisk、Western Digital 此前因指引承压，说明存储链交易进入“价格和库存验证”阶段；但 Sparks 中 AI PC、光通信、人脸识别仍有正收益行，A股 CPO、光模块、消费电子零部件可看相对强弱，不宜无差别追芯片。
中概
热门中概微涨但内部宽度不足，平台股靠个股催化而非指数共振
Sparks 热门中概股 +0.59%，ZLAB +13.66% 但板块涨跌家数为16/21/0；这意味着港股恒生科技今日更依赖美团、阿里、腾讯各自催化和南向资金承接，而不是单纯跟随中概指数。
财报
可验证 A/H 财报结果不足，Futu OpenD 子检查受限
按规则尝试 HK/SH/SZ 财报日历和 NOTICE 公告搜索，但本机 OpenD 连接 127.0.0.1:11111 被拒绝；未用美股公司财报填充 A/H 财报模块，今日只保留“公告检查受限/财报空窗”的风险提示。
政策
香港离岸人民币产品扩容继续支撑金融基础设施叙事
香港近期推出离岸中国国债期货并强化人民币债券、黄金和流动性安排，有利于交易所、券商和人民币资产配置主题；但短线需看港股保险税务扰动是否继续压制金融权重。
本地
前一交易日 A股偏稳、港股受保险拖累，今日需要科技链接力
Reuters 报道前一交易日内地股市大体持稳、黄金股对冲科技走弱，香港市场受保险股下跌拖累；若今日科技链不能接力，指数更可能维持震荡而非单边上攻。

盘前结论

今天可交易的利多线索较窄但清晰：Sparks 指向激光雷达、锂矿、太空/无人机和外卖映射，而不是科技股全面反弹。舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链需要开盘后用成交量确认。

宏观天花板同样明确：油价上行和 10Y 美债约 4.67% 会降低市场对高估值成长的容忍度。美股软件与存储负反馈意味着 A/H 云软件和泛芯片要先经过价格过滤。

基准判断是 A/H 指数震荡、板块轮动强于指数 beta。若恒生科技强于恒指且南向资金买入平台股，早盘可以略偏积极；否则能源、黄金和金融基础设施主题更容易保持相对强势。

触发因素：若开盘后强于恒生科技且成交放大，说明美股激光雷达异动被港股资金承接。

风险点：AEVA 单股涨幅很大但不等于行业订单全面改善，若港股汽车链走弱，映射交易会快速降温。

触发因素：港股 1772.HK 与 A股锂矿指数同步放量上行，且碳酸锂期货不再走弱。

风险点：主题波动大且部分个股估值不低，若大盘风险偏好下降，容易出现冲高回落。

板块轮动看板

受益方向激光雷达、锂矿、低空经济/卫星互联网、外卖平台；这是 Sparks 正收益 Top5 对 A/H 最直接的映射。
观察方向AI PC、光通信、人脸识别仍有正收益线索，但需要 CPO、消费电子和港股硬件成交确认。
压力方向软件SaaS、数据平台、存储链和高估值成长；美股负反馈提示 A/H 软件云服务先看止跌。
验证信号恒生科技能否强于恒指、南向是否净流入平台股、10Y美债是否继续上冲、油价是否维持高位。

逻辑链

宏观底色

隔夜美股小跌但油价和美债上行，A/H 高估值科技先受估值折现约束。

Sparks 输入

激光雷达、锂矿、太空和外卖成为正收益前列，资金偏向“事件+资源+硬件映射”。

A/H 映射

对应舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链，开盘必须用成交和相对强弱确认。

压力过滤

软件和存储负反馈要求回避单纯讲 AI 故事但没有价格承接的标的。

交易结论

指数大概率震荡，优先做强映射的确认交易，弱板块只等止跌信号。

风险雷达

非农若强于预期，10Y 美债继续上行会压制港股互联网和 A股成长估值。

油价若延续上涨，航空、化工中下游和消费成本链会承压，同时通胀预期扰动外资风险偏好。

Sparks 强势板块包含单股驱动成分，若 A/H 对应标的开盘不跟随，说明映射交易失效。

Major News Summary
Global
Hormuz uncertainty kept oil elevated, giving A/H energy security and shipping an event premium
The key constraint behind the overnight US pullback was the joint rise in oil and Treasury yields. Middle East and Iran-related negotiations have not produced a stable reopening expectation, so A-share oil, oilfield services, shipping, and inflation-beneficiary chains may attract defensive money, while airlines, downstream chemicals, and high-valuation growth face pressure.
Macro
US long yields rose before payrolls, limiting valuation upside for Hong Kong growth shares
Public market reports show the Dow down 0.85%, the S&P 500 down 0.18%, and the Nasdaq down 0.06% on August 6, with the US 10-year yield near 4.67%. If tonight’s payrolls are strong, Hong Kong internet and high-valuation A-share technology rebounds should first face rate pressure.
Tech
Futunn Sparks showed lidar, lithium, space, and food delivery as the strongest overnight chains
The positive top five were Lidar Technology +4.92% (AEVA +28.81%), Lithium Mining +3.99% (ALB +5.54%), Firearm Manufacturers +3.72% (CDRE +12.86%), Space +3.44% (BKSY +10.37%), and Food Delivery +3.17% (UBER +3.36%). A/H mapping focuses on smart-driving sensors, lithium resources, low-altitude economy/satellite internet, and Meituan.
Software
US software saw a high-expectation penalty, so A/H software and cloud services need stabilization first
HubSpot, Datadog, AppLovin, Figma, and Duolingo were sold on earnings, guidance, and AI-pricing concerns, showing that investors no longer reward revenue beats alone. Kingdee, Ming Yuan Cloud, and A-share software services need volume stabilization before chase buying.
Chips
Memory and semiconductors diverged, while AI PC and optical communication still had structural mapping
Sandisk and Western Digital had been pressured by guidance, showing that memory trading has moved into price and inventory verification. But Sparks still showed positive rows for AI PC, optical communication, and facial recognition, so A-share CPO, optical modules, and consumer-electronics components should be judged by relative strength rather than chased broadly.
China ADRs
China ADRs rose only slightly and breadth was weak, so platform shares need individual catalysts
Sparks showed China Concept Stocks up 0.59%, led by ZLAB +13.66%, but breadth was 16/21/0. That means Hang Seng Tech today depends more on Meituan, Alibaba, and Tencent-specific catalysts plus southbound support than on simple China ADR index beta.
Earnings
Verifiable A/H earnings results were insufficient because Futu OpenD child checks were limited
HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE checks were attempted as required, but local OpenD refused 127.0.0.1:11111. No US company earnings were used to fill the A/H earnings module; today keeps only the earnings-window limitation as a risk note.
Policy
Hong Kong offshore RMB product expansion still supports financial-infrastructure themes
Recent offshore Chinese government bond futures plus RMB bond, gold, and liquidity measures in Hong Kong support exchange, brokerage, and RMB asset-allocation themes. Short term, investors still need to watch whether insurance-tax concerns keep weighing on financial weights.
Local
A-shares were steady while Hong Kong was dragged by insurers, so today needs a technology handoff
Reuters reported that mainland stocks were broadly steady in the prior session as gold miners offset technology weakness, while Hong Kong was pressured by insurers. If technology cannot take over today, the index is more likely to stay range-bound than trend higher.

Premarket View

The constructive lead is narrow but tradable: Sparks points to lidar, lithium, space/drone, and food-delivery mappings rather than a broad technology rebound. Sunny Optical, Ganfeng Lithium, Meituan, and low-altitude economy names need to prove the mapping through volume after the open.

The macro ceiling is also clear: higher oil and a US 10-year yield near 4.67% reduce the market’s tolerance for high-valuation growth. Software and memory weakness in the US means A/H cloud software and broad chip names should first be filtered by price confirmation.

The base case is a range-bound A/H open with sector rotation stronger than index beta. If Hang Seng Tech beats the Hang Seng Index and southbound money buys platform shares, the morning can lean slightly positive; otherwise defensive energy, gold, and financial-infrastructure themes should hold relative strength.
